GRANT_ID_ALLOCATION_DISPOSITION.binding: THIS ADDENDUM ALLOCATES ONE NEW GRANT ID: HPO-ODS-W2-26. This is the first grant-axis advance since HPO-ODS-W2-25, and it is stated as one rather than presented as routine.
GRANT_ID_ALLOCATION_DISPOSITION.why_a_new_id_rather_than_a_reuse: A GRANT_ID names an ACT OF AUTHORITY over an implementation surface. v1.0.25, v1.0.26 and v1.0.27 reused HPO-ODS-W2-25 because each governed THE SAME act, over THE SAME surface, on THE SAME branch. CE-1 satisfies none of those three identities: a DIFFERENT node (CommercialAccount CE-1, not multi-org S3 refusal audit), a DIFFERENT protected surface (three patterns including db/prepared/checkpoint-b0/observation.sql, which W2-25 does not carry), and a DIFFERENT branch. Reusing HPO-ODS-W2-25 would be the mirror-image error of the one v1.0.25 refused: it would assert that ONE act now spans two unrelated nodes, and — decisively — it would not resolve, because resolveProtectedGrant matches grant.branch against the CURRENT BRANCH by exact string equality and W2-25 is bound to codex/multiorg-s3-refusal-audit-implementation-r1.
